360	Now, you know what it was like: a father, three children. They were so poor
361	that they split one egg into four pieces.
362	He and his wife would each eat a quarter, and each child would get a quarter.
363	Such poverty reigned in those times.
364	And the poor man had no job, he was unemployed, he had nothing to eat.
365	Then, thank HaShem, HaShem gave him an idea: that his father would sell
366	his apartment and they would build a building. I don't remember exactly what his strategy was.
367	Today the man has become a very big millionaire.

371	He answered, I would be a video editor, a video technician.
372	He said to him, wrong, you would be unemployed. Why?
373	Because today there are no video technicians at all anymore.
374	You hear what the best-known ones and the doctors...?
375	When the Holy One, blessed be He, gives you some pain, some hardship, some trauma, some drama, remember, you are
376	meant to do one thing.
377	To correct your deeds.
378	Fearing the situation is pointless, it isn't real, it's a lie, it isn't HaShem's will.
379	And sadly, many religious people get this wrong.
380	Many people who sit and learn Torah get this wrong.
381	If you are in distress, my good soul, you don't know the Creator of the world.
382	If something happened to you that doesn't suit you, dear lady, say a match fell through, or there was
383	some problem with your teacher, with your friend, with your parents.
384	And so on, you shouldn't be upset by it, because the Holy One, blessed be He, did it and it is the best thing in the world.
385	Who will be in power doesn't matter; the hearts of kings and princes are in HaShem's hand. How simple, how
386	clear. If you didn't succeed in some deal, it is the best thing in the world. What do you
387	need to draw from it?
388	You must learn, draw the lessons from it, take stock, correct
389	your character traits. If we understood this correctly, my good souls, I want to bring you to the stage where you understand, dear and beloved brothers,
390	that we live in a world that the Holy One, blessed be He, runs.
391	I want you to succeed. Today we don't do things because we are afraid we will fail, we are afraid
392	we will fall, we are afraid that, as it were, the Holy One, blessed be He, is not with us.
393	Rabbi Yosef Chaim, my tzaddik, the Holy One, blessed be He, understand this, write it well in your head,
394	and I sign it with my own hand, I'll sign it for you for a million dollars.
395	The Holy One, blessed be He, is with you every moment and every second.
396	In the darkest moments of your life, the Holy One, blessed be He, was there so that you would reach the place where you are today, thank
397	HaShem.
398	Understand, when you were born without teeth, that's something you say to yourself, Elokim, what is going on here?
399	Why did HaShem do this?
400	Was it good or was it not good?
401	It was excellent.
402	When you fell on the way to demolition, why was that good?
403	Because the Holy One, blessed be He, created the world in such a way that in order to grow, one must make an effort. It is a world
404	of chessed, a world in which the Holy One, blessed be He, wants us brave, strong, hard-working, reaching
405	high levels.

409	There was a Jew who was the gabbai of a synagogue.

417	The signature is sort of in the shape of a check mark, a small one.
